meta.title: Manufacturing · Clafina
meta.description: Plan, schedule, make and cost what you produce, from the bill of materials to finished goods in stock, with quality checks on the way.

hero.title: From the bill of materials to finished goods on the shelf.
hero.lede: Plan production orders, schedule machines and people, run the floor and see what each work order really cost. Stock, buying and the books follow by themselves.

jobs.title: Know if you can deliver
jobs.body: Ask whether you can deliver by a date. The answer shows what it depends on: materials, machines, people and the work already planned.

jobs.title: The right work on every machine
jobs.body: A scheduler plans around capacity, maintenance and breakdowns. Move work by machine, by person or by order when the day changes.

jobs.title: What it really cost
jobs.body: Each work order is costed from what happened on the floor, next to what it should have cost, with the difference posted as variance.

tour.title: Follow a work order on the floor
tour.body: Operators start, pause and report good and spoilt units from their screen. A breakdown shows on the work order the moment it is logged.
points: Stops are kept with reason codes
Labels with QR codes open the work order on any phone camera
The floor keeps working offline and syncs later

tour.title: See what is short before it stops you
tour.body: Planning holds the materials each order needs. What is short raises a requisition, so buying sees it straight away.
points: Sub-assemblies are planned with the product
Automations alert you to shortages, delays and breakdowns

tour.title: Release only what passes
tour.body: Output waits in Awaiting release until quality releases it. What fails gets a non-conformance report and a corrective action.
points: Inspection plans and gates that stop the next step
Trace a lot back to its materials, or forward to where it went

connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Materials are taken from stock and finished goods go back into it.
Work in progress and variances post to the ledger.
People and rosters set who can work when.
Maintenance on machines shows in the schedule.
Manufacturing projects keep phases, milestones and deliverables with your other projects.

faq.q: Can it tell me if we can deliver by a date?
faq.a: Yes. Ask for a date and it answers with the factors behind it: materials held or short, capacity and the work already planned.

faq.q: Does the shop floor keep working when the connection drops?
faq.a: Yes. The operator's screen keeps working offline and syncs when the connection is back.

faq.q: Can finished goods be sold before quality has checked them?
faq.a: No. Output waits in Awaiting release until quality releases it, and cannot be sold until then.
